translations.web: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
translations.bsb: If a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?
translations.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
translations.asv: If therefore the uncircumcision keep the ordinances of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be reckoned for circumcision?
